I am trying to formalize certain aspects of the Dolev-Yao model, and am stuck at mutually defining boolean equality of terms (DYTerm.beq), and of normalization of terms (DYTerm.normalize). Previously, I had attempted to reduce this problem to an MWE, came to know about the limitations of the mutual block in the current Lean version, and was also shown a way to make it work using well-founded recursion.

I have tried to extend the solution for the MWE to my actual use-case, but have failed to prove termination for the mutual definitions. I would be very happy to hear any ideas about how I can make this work. Thanks in advance!

Some explanation about the code (please ask if any further clarifications are needed).

  • DYTerm.nonce represents atomic terms (or atomic messages in the communication stream), DYTerm.pair represents pair of two messages, DYTerm.senc represents symmetric encryption of a message by another message, and DYTerm.dxor represents XOR of a list of messages.
  • Boolean equality of DYTerms checks whether the normal forms of two messages are equal (where we consider XOR as being commutative, associative, nilpotent and having left and right identity)
  • Normalization of a DYTerm (DYTerm.normalize) flattens nested lists of XOR-ed messages and applies simplification rules of commutativity, associativity, nilpotency and identity to the XOR lists.
inductive DYTerm where
| nonce : Nat → DYTerm
| pair  : DYTerm → DYTerm → DYTerm
| senc  : DYTerm → DYTerm → DYTerm
| dxor  : List DYTerm → DYTerm
deriving Repr
-- Zero is defined as dxor []

open DYTerm

mutual

  def List.getSize : List DYTerm → Nat
  | []      => 1
  | x :: xs => x.getSize + xs.getSize + 1

  def DYTerm.getSize : DYTerm → Nat
  | nonce _     => 1
  | pair t1 t2  => t1.getSize + t2.getSize + 1
  | senc t1 t2  => t1.getSize + t2.getSize + 1
  | dxor l      => l.getSize + 1

end

mutual

  def DYTerm.beq s t := match s, t with
  | nonce m, nonce n                => m == n
  | pair s1 s2, pair t1 t2          => s1.beq t1 && s2.beq t2
  | senc s1 s2, senc t1 t2          => s1.beq t1 && s2.beq t2
  | dxor l1, dxor l2                =>
    let l1norm := l1.normalize'
    let l2norm := l2.normalize'
    l1norm.length == l2norm.length && (l1norm.diff l2norm).length == 0
  | dxor l1, t2                     => match h : l1.normalize' with
    | [x] => x.beq t2
    | _ => false
  | t1, dxor l2                     => match h : l2.normalize' with
    | [x] => t1.beq x
    | _ => false
  | _, _                            => false
  -- termination_by s.getSize + t.getSize
  -- decreasing_by
  --   all_goals sorry

  def List.has (t : DYTerm) : List DYTerm → Bool
  | []      => false
  | x :: xs => x.beq t || xs.has t
  -- termination_by l => t.getSize + l.getSize

  def List.remove (t : DYTerm) : List DYTerm → List DYTerm
  | []      => []
  | x :: xs => if x.beq t then xs else x :: (xs.remove t)
  -- termination_by l => t.getSize + l.getSize

  def List.diff (l1 : List DYTerm) : List DYTerm → List DYTerm
  | []      => l1
  | x :: xs => (l1.remove x).diff xs
  -- termination_by l2 => l1.getSize + l2.getSize
  -- decreasing_by
  --   all_goals sorry

  def List.normalize' : List DYTerm → List DYTerm
  | []              => []
  | (dxor l1) :: l2 => (l1 ++ l2).normalize'
  | x :: xs         =>
    let xsnorm := xs.normalize'
    if xsnorm.has x then xsnorm.remove x else x.normalize :: xsnorm
  -- termination_by l => l.getSize

  def DYTerm.normalize : DYTerm → DYTerm
  | nonce n     => nonce n
  | pair t1 t2  => pair t1.normalize t2.normalize
  | senc t1 t2  => senc t1.normalize t2.normalize
  | dxor l      => match l.normalize' with
    | [x]   => x
    | lnorm => dxor lnorm
  -- termination_by t => t.getSize

end


-- Commutativity
#eval! (dxor [nonce 1, nonce 2]).beq (dxor [nonce 2, nonce 1])

-- Associativity
#eval! (dxor [nonce 1, dxor [nonce 2, nonce 3]]).beq (dxor [dxor [nonce 1, nonce 2], nonce 3])

-- Left identity
#eval! (dxor [dxor [], nonce 1]).normalize

-- Right identity
#eval! (dxor [nonce 1, dxor []]).normalize

-- Nilpotency
#eval! (dxor [nonce 1, nonce 1]).normalize

I only had a quick look, but have two comments:

  • Is your getSize maybe the same as the automatically generated sizeOf?
  • It seems that List.normalize' is making a recursive call to something longer/larger, so l.getSize does not go down there. What is the informal argument that the function will terminate? / What is the property of l1 in that line ensuring it? Maybe you need a lexicographic ordering on a tuple?

I would recommend drawing the "which function calls which other function" graph with pen and paper, and then annotate the edges with "what goes down / becomes simpler". Similar to the Lean output you already get that says things like this:

Call from DYTerm.beq to DYTerm.beq at 29:39-48:
 #1 #2
  <  <

@Malvin Gattinger

  • Instead of the built-in sizeOf definition, I have used my own getSize functions, defined at the starting of the file. I am not entirely sure if it is the same as the sizeOf definition.
  • List.normalize' makes 5 recursive calls, could you please clarify which one of those you are asking about?

For example,
In the line (dxor l1) :: l2 => (l1 ++ l2).normalize', size drops from l1.length + l2.length + (sum of getSize of all elements in l1) + (sum of getSize of all elements in l2) + 4 to l1.length + l2.length + (sum of getSize of all elements in l1) + (sum of getSize of all elements in l2) + 1.

#eval (dxor [nonce 1] :: [nonce 2]).getSize -- returns 8
#eval (nonce 1 :: [nonce 2]).getSize -- returns 5
One of the main issues with that I am facing is that the current mutual block does not support unfolding definitions while in the termination proof, as mentioned here.

I see. Yes, (dxor l1) :: l2 => (l1 ++ l2).normalize' was the line I worried about. But I now see that it is not one of the challenging ones. I played around with the code a bit more but don't have any other ideas unfortunately. I'll still dump my last attempt with 6 sorries left, all involving PSigma hypotheses that cannot be unfolded I guess.

inductive DYTerm where
| nonce : Nat → DYTerm
| pair  : DYTerm → DYTerm → DYTerm
| senc  : DYTerm → DYTerm → DYTerm
| dxor  : List DYTerm → DYTerm
deriving Repr
-- Zero is defined as dxor []

open DYTerm

mutual

  @[grind .]
  def List.getSize : List DYTerm → Nat
  | []      => 1
  | x :: xs => x.getSize + xs.getSize + 1

  @[grind .]
  def DYTerm.getSize : DYTerm → Nat
  | nonce _     => 1
  | pair t1 t2  => t1.getSize + t2.getSize + 1
  | senc t1 t2  => t1.getSize + t2.getSize + 1
  | dxor l      => l.getSize + 1

end

theorem getSize_dxor : (l1 ++ l2).getSize < (dxor l1 :: l2).getSize := by
  induction l1 <;> induction l2 <;> grind

mutual

  def DYTerm.beq s t := match s, t with
  | nonce m, nonce n                => m == n
  | pair s1 s2, pair t1 t2          => s1.beq t1 && s2.beq t2
  | senc s1 s2, senc t1 t2          => s1.beq t1 && s2.beq t2
  | dxor l1, dxor l2                =>
    let l1norm := l1.normalize'
    let l2norm := l2.normalize'
    l1norm.length == l2norm.length && (l1norm.diff l2norm).length == 0
  | dxor l1, t2                     => match h : l1.normalize' with
    | [x] => x.beq t2
    | _ => false
  | t1, dxor l2                     => match h : l2.normalize' with
    | [x] => t1.beq x
    | _ => false
  | _, _                            => false
  termination_by s.getSize + t.getSize
  decreasing_by
    all_goals (simp_wf <;> try grind)
    · sorry
    · -- But we know nothing that relates `l1` and `x` here?
      sorry
    · sorry

  def List.has (t : DYTerm) : List DYTerm → Bool
  | []      => false
  | x :: xs => x.beq t || xs.has t
  termination_by l => t.getSize + l.getSize
  decreasing_by
    all_goals (simp_wf <;> try grind)

  def List.remove (t : DYTerm) : List DYTerm → List DYTerm
  | []      => []
  | x :: xs => if x.beq t then xs else x :: (xs.remove t)
  termination_by l => t.getSize + l.getSize
  decreasing_by
    all_goals (simp_wf <;> try grind)

  def List.diff (l1 : List DYTerm) : List DYTerm → List DYTerm
  | []      => l1
  | x :: xs => (l1.remove x).diff xs
  termination_by l2 => l1.getSize + l2.getSize
  decreasing_by
    all_goals (simp_wf <;> try grind)
    · sorry

  def List.normalize' : List DYTerm → List DYTerm
  | []              => []
  | (dxor l1) :: l2 => (l1 ++ l2).normalize' -- This was the line Malvin worried about.
  | x :: xs         =>
    let xsnorm := xs.normalize'
    if xsnorm.has x then xsnorm.remove x else x.normalize :: xsnorm
  termination_by l => l.getSize
  decreasing_by
  · apply getSize_dxor
  · simp_wf <;> grind
  · simp [List.getSize]
    sorry
  · sorry
  · simp_wf <;> simp [List.getSize]; omega

  def DYTerm.normalize : DYTerm → DYTerm
  | nonce n     => nonce n
  | pair t1 t2  => pair t1.normalize t2.normalize
  | senc t1 t2  => senc t1.normalize t2.normalize
  | dxor l      => match l.normalize' with
    | [x]   => x
    | lnorm => dxor lnorm
  termination_by t => t.getSize
  decreasing_by
  all_goals simp_wf <;> grind

end

-- Commutativity
#eval! (dxor [nonce 1, nonce 2]).beq (dxor [nonce 2, nonce 1])

-- Associativity
#eval! (dxor [nonce 1, dxor [nonce 2, nonce 3]]).beq (dxor [dxor [nonce 1, nonce 2], nonce 3])

-- Left identity
#eval! (dxor [dxor [], nonce 1]).normalize

-- Right identity
#eval! (dxor [nonce 1, dxor []]).normalize

-- Nilpotency
#eval! (dxor [nonce 1, nonce 1]).normalize

Sorry for bumping this to the top; but does anyone have any ideas how to make this work?

I would be happy to provide further clarifications regarding the issue if required.

I think I am almost done with this problem. I had to rework the DYTerm datatype to separate out the XOR component, and this is hopefully something semantically equivalent:

mutual

  inductive Std where
  | nonce : Nat → Std
  | pair  : DYTerm → DYTerm → Std
  | senc  : DYTerm → DYTerm → Std

  inductive NonStd where
  | dxor  : List Std → NonStd

  inductive DYTerm where
  | inl   : Std → DYTerm
  | inr   : NonStd → DYTerm

end

open Std NonStd DYTerm

mutual

  @[grind]
  def List.getSize : List Std → Nat
  | []      => 1
  | x :: xs => x.getSize + xs.getSize + 1

  @[grind]
  def Std.getSize : Std → Nat
  | nonce _     => 1
  | pair t1 t2  => t1.getSize + t2.getSize + 1
  | senc t1 t2  => t1.getSize + t2.getSize + 1

  @[grind]
  def NonStd.getSize : NonStd → Nat
  | dxor l => l.getSize + 1

  @[grind]
  def DYTerm.getSize : DYTerm → Nat
  | inl t => 1 + t.getSize
  | inr t => 1 + t.getSize

end

mutual

  def Std.beq : Std → Std → Bool
  | nonce m, nonce n        => m == n
  | pair s1 s2, pair t1 t2  => s1.beq t1 && s2.beq t2
  | senc s1 s2, senc t1 t2  => s1.beq t1 && s2.beq t2
  | _, _                    => false
  termination_by s t => 2 * (s.getSize + t.getSize)
  decreasing_by
    all_goals grind only [Std.getSize]

  def NonStd.beq : NonStd → NonStd → Bool
  | dxor l1, dxor l2 => cancels (l1 ++ l2)
  termination_by s t => 2 * (s.getSize + t.getSize)
  decreasing_by
    induction l1 <;> grind only [NonStd.getSize, = List.cons_append, List.getSize]

  def DYTerm.beq : DYTerm → DYTerm → Bool
  | inl s, inl t          => s.beq t
  | inr s, inr t          => s.beq t
  | inr (dxor l), inl t   => cancels (t :: l)
  | inl s, inr (dxor l)   => cancels (s :: l)
  termination_by s t => 2 * (s.getSize + t.getSize)
  decreasing_by
    all_goals grind only [DYTerm.getSize, List.getSize, NonStd.getSize]

  def List.help (l : List Std) (m : {x : Nat // x < l.length}) (n : {x : Nat // x < l.length}) (hneq : m != n) : Nat :=
    if l[m.val].beq l[n.val] then 1 else 0
  termination_by 2 * l.getSize
  decreasing_by
    suffices l[m.val].getSize + l[n.val].getSize < l.getSize by
      lia
    sorry

  def cancels (l : List Std) : Bool :=
    let rng := (List.range l.length).attachWith (fun x => x < l.length) (by grind)
    rng.all (fun x => (rng.map (fun y => if h : x == y then 0 else (l.help x y (by grind only)))).sum % 2 == 1)
  termination_by 2 * l.getSize + 1

end

def fnonce := inl ∘ nonce
def fsenc := Function.curry (inl ∘ Function.uncurry senc)
def fpair := Function.curry (inl ∘ Function.uncurry pair)
def fxor := inr ∘ dxor

#eval! (fxor [pair (fnonce 1) (fxor [nonce 1, nonce 4]), nonce 2]).beq (fxor [nonce 2, pair (fnonce 1) (fxor [nonce 4, nonce 1])])
#eval! (fxor [nonce 1, nonce 1, nonce 42]).beq (fnonce 42)
#eval! (fxor [senc (fxor [nonce 1, nonce 2]) (fnonce 4)]).beq (fsenc (fxor [nonce 2, nonce 1]) (fnonce 4))

Now the only bit left is the sorry in the decreasing_by block in List.help; and I have asked about it separately here.

Finally! @Vlad Tsyrklevich and @Snir Broshi helped put together the final bit, and the last remaining sorry is now gone.

Thanks to everyone in the Zulip community who helped me resolve the issues that I faced in this project. Thanks a lot!

This is the code that I have now :

-- # =======================================================================================================

mutual

  inductive Std where
  | nonce : Nat → Std
  | pair  : DYTerm → DYTerm → Std
  | senc  : DYTerm → DYTerm → Std

  inductive NonStd where
  | dxor  : List Std → NonStd

  inductive DYTerm where
  | inl   : Std → DYTerm
  | inr   : NonStd → DYTerm

end

open Std NonStd DYTerm

-- # =======================================================================================================

mutual

  @[grind]
  def List.getSize : List Std → Nat
  | []      => 1
  | x :: xs => x.getSize + xs.getSize + 1

  @[grind]
  def Std.getSize : Std → Nat
  | nonce _     => 1
  | pair t1 t2  => t1.getSize + t2.getSize + 1
  | senc t1 t2  => t1.getSize + t2.getSize + 1

  @[grind]
  def NonStd.getSize : NonStd → Nat
  | dxor l => l.getSize + 1

  @[grind]
  def DYTerm.getSize : DYTerm → Nat
  | inl t => 1 + t.getSize
  | inr t => 1 + t.getSize

end

-- # =======================================================================================================

-- Alternative shorter version at
-- https://leanprover.zulipchat.com/#narrow/channel/113488-general/topic/Stuck.20at.20a.20proof.20involving.20list.20summation/near/610821885

theorem help_lemma1 (l : List Std) (m : {x // x < l.length}) : l[m.val].getSize < l.getSize := by
  induction l
  . grind only [usr Subtype.property, = List.length_nil]
  . rename_i y ys ih
    dsimp [List.getSize]
    induction m
    rename_i mv mp
    induction mv
    . grind only [= List.getElem_cons]
    . rename_i n ih2
      dsimp at *
      have := ih ⟨n, (by grind only [= List.length_cons])⟩
      lia

theorem help_lemma2 (l : List Std) (m n : {x // x < l.length}) (h : m < n) : l[m.val].getSize + l[n.val].getSize < l.getSize := by
    induction l
    . grind only [usr Subtype.property, = List.length_nil]
    rename_i y ys ih
    dsimp [List.getSize]
    by_cases h' : m.val = 0
    . simp [h']
      have : n.val != 0 := by grind only
      induction n
      rename_i nv np
      induction nv; contradiction
      rename_i n ih2
      dsimp at *
      have np' : n < ys.length := by grind only [= List.length_cons]
      suffices ys[n].getSize < ys.getSize by lia
      exact help_lemma1 ys ⟨n, np'⟩
    . induction m
      rename_i mv mp
      induction mv; contradiction
      rename_i m ih2
      dsimp at *
      induction n
      rename_i nv np
      induction nv; contradiction
      rename_i n ih3
      dsimp at *
      have := ih ⟨m, by grind only [= List.length_cons]⟩
        ⟨n, by grind only [= List.length_cons]⟩ (Nat.succ_lt_succ_iff.mp h)
      lia

-- # =======================================================================================================

mutual

  def Std.beq : Std → Std → Bool
  | nonce m, nonce n        => m == n
  | pair s1 s2, pair t1 t2  => s1.beq t1 && s2.beq t2
  | senc s1 s2, senc t1 t2  => s1.beq t1 && s2.beq t2
  | _, _                    => false
  termination_by s t => 2 * (s.getSize + t.getSize)
  decreasing_by
    all_goals grind only [Std.getSize]

  def NonStd.beq : NonStd → NonStd → Bool
  | dxor l1, dxor l2 => (l1 ++ l2).cancels
  termination_by s t => 2 * (s.getSize + t.getSize)
  decreasing_by
    induction l1 <;> grind only [NonStd.getSize, = List.cons_append, List.getSize]

  def DYTerm.beq : DYTerm → DYTerm → Bool
  | inl s, inl t          => s.beq t
  | inr s, inr t          => s.beq t
  | inr (dxor l), inl t   => (t :: l).cancels
  | inl s, inr (dxor l)   => (s :: l).cancels
  termination_by s t => 2 * (s.getSize + t.getSize)
  decreasing_by
    all_goals grind only [DYTerm.getSize, List.getSize, NonStd.getSize]

  def List.help (l : List Std) (m : {x : Nat // x < l.length}) (n : {x : Nat // x < l.length}) (_ : m != n) : Nat :=
    if l[m.val].beq l[n.val] then 1 else 0
  termination_by 2 * l.getSize
  decreasing_by
    by_cases h2 : m < n
    . have := help_lemma2 l m n h2; lia
    . have := help_lemma2 l n m (by grind only); lia

  def List.cancels (l : List Std) : Bool :=
    let rng := (List.range l.length).attachWith (fun x => x < l.length) (by grind only [= List.mem_range])
    rng.all (fun x => (rng.map (fun y => if h : x == y then 0 else (l.help x y (by grind only)))).sum % 2 == 1)
  termination_by 2 * l.getSize + 1

end

-- # =======================================================================================================
